items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of H.M. Prince is made by the interviewer as a guess about a band member.

ctx.x: Did you hear him with the original Creole, the Bill Johnson's band? And they're on the stage?
No, I'm not gonna say... They played the first time I heard that. I never... That was... They had a fella... Entertainer. Who was his band. I'm quite sure. H.M. Prince.
I think was the fella. Yeah.
